whatWeDoText: Engineering services offered include: FERC filing assistance, feasibility studies, preliminary engineering, FEED (Front End Engineering Design) packages, detail design, construction management,and start-up commissioning support. TKE personnel have considerable experience in all phases of a project and carry the ability to utilize lessons learned from past projects to ensure new projects move smoothly, on time, on budget, and safe.
aboutText: TKE Engineering & Design, Inc. is a multi-discipline consulting engineering company serving the gas and liquid pipeline industry for over 30 years. The company was started in Houston, Texas in 1992 by Terry Eleiott, PE. TKE performs engineering and design services for projects throughout the continental United States.
